budget.additional_payment_actions: No top-up, subscription, credit purchase, new paid service, HCLA budget transfer or post-run reuse.
budget.cny_reference: 13.544640 at independently published CNY9/27 peak rates; not an exchange-rate conversion, not a second spending pool.
budget.reservation_basis: Existing conservative code bound, not a new model-tokenizer guarantee or a verified invoice. Require exact request serialization and recheck official rates before launch.

completion_token_cap_scope: Each phase max_tokens caps total generated completion, including reasoning tokens and visible final output together; no separate second thinking allowance.

evidence.content_retention_limit: Final message.content is retained only within the predeclared 64000-character bound. Transport-unknown or missing-content outcomes remain absent with exact safe status and held cost, never reconstructed. Reasoning and complete provider envelopes are never persisted or published.
evidence.content_scope: Five original fictional source/questions plus final answer content/citations/uncertainty/assumptions, fixed failure codes and usage/identity/timing summaries; no personal content.
evidence.existing_missing_output: Historical D01 raw output is not reconstructed, rescored or claimed diagnosed.
evidence.publication: No publication now. Proposed future approval explicitly covers the public GitHub repository haohongfei2001-png/human-cognition-layer for these five synthetic materials and at most nine unchanged final outputs plus bounded evidence only. If public-output permission is withheld, do not silently use GitHub logs/artifacts; establish a supported private result route before any API call.
evidence.raw_failure_retention: Preserve bounded final message.content verbatim BEFORE schema validation, including malformed/noncanonical content, so a new delivery failure is diagnosable. This does not permit storing or sharing reasoning_content, raw plans, full provider envelopes, credentials or unrelated private receipts.

limitations: Source cases use English and cannot validate general Chinese user experience.
Planning uses diagnostic16384 rather than ordinary4096; success does not certify the ordinary default path.
One run per arm is sensitive to stochastic sampling and provider alias/backend drift.
No equality of compute budget between arms.
No effect claim from local regression-test counts.
No HCLA activation or security-review work.
preparation_gates: Revalidate exact a961e00d runtime tree/hash and current official model/rates; no paid preflight.
Build a NEW isolated execution package, exact source/question/rubric/request hashes, one-run ledger and strict output allowlist; existing consumed runners cannot be reused.
Prove every static request fits36000bytes; reserve all dynamic HCL final requests at full36000bytes. If full source/policy/results exceed cap, fail that declared arm before dispatch, never trim.
Verify actual wire max_tokens caps combined generation and complete usage accounting with provider-free request tests; no default64K output.
Independent scope/budget/retention review and zero-provider tests before any activation.
Obtain explicit new per-run cost and data/publication approval. No grant/token/config/payment created by this proposal.

call_order: HCL answer if native result exists
stage1.failure: Any failed/unknown gate ends the entire two-stage authorization; stage2 remains NOT_ATTEMPTED. No repair/retry/extra sample.
stage1.interpretation: One functional demonstration only; no comparison, reliability-rate or efficacy claim.
pass_gate: Exact frozen runtime/request and allowed model identity.
At least one real native result from ordinary planner selection; no forced module or Base fallback.
Returned complete usage/cost and finish status, nonblank final answer, explicit citation objects, unchanged source audit and common strict consumer pass.
Source-first check satisfies all four predeclared SMOKE1 criteria.
stage1.purpose: Current repaired path can select and execute native work and deliver one correct source-cited final answer.

stage2.fairness: Same original source/question, same current explicit-citation meaning/shape policy and source-cited-answer acceptance for both arms; same provider, model alias, high thinking, 8192 final token cap. Fresh isolated session per arm; no other arm output, rubric or expected result in prompts. HCL alone has the disclosed 16384-token planning call; this is NOT compute-matched and cannot attribute causality to a module.
stage2.global_stop: Unknown transmission/usage/cost, timeout, model drift, price increase, source/runtime/hash drift, unsafe/missing accounting, budget admission failure or user stop closes both stages; remaining slots NOT_ATTEMPTED.
stage2.interpretation: At most a fresh assistant-authored development signal. Not a representative benchmark, no statistical significance/generalization, no module-causal claim, no I02 completion. Reusing old answered cases would be regression only; these new authored texts are not independent external evidence.
stage2.known_failure: Known bounded content/schema/native-selection/overflow failures with complete accounting remain failures in their original slots; continue only other predeclared slots. No replacement, repair or retry.
metrics: 4/4 planned-item denominator for each arm; failed or missing final deliveries score0, content-only quality is NA.
Per-item and total blind source-first scores (0..10 each, total0..40).
All losses/ties/harms and valid-empty citation failures remain visible.
End-to-end arm latency includes HCL planning/native work plus final generation; record each call and total cost.
Native selected/executed/checked-treatment facts reported after score lock; invocation is not efficacy proof.
stage2.no_tuning: All five sources, questions, criteria, execution order and acceptance/scoring rules frozen before stage1. No choosing or changing stage2 based on stage1 output.

rubric.content: Four predeclared facts, each1 point; accurate semantically equivalent answers accepted.
rubric.delivery_gate: Exact allowed fields and types, nonblank answer, at least one explicit citation, original source audit including versions/location. Failure=0 end-to-end, content-only=NA; never rewrite to satisfy gate.
rubric.traceability: Three binary points: at least one correctly attributed relevant citation; central factual claims supported by those citations/source; no quotation used to imply an unsupported mental/causal claim.

stage2.scoring: One independent source-first reviewer sees source/question/rubric and unchanged final content under shuffled IDs, no arm label/capabilities/latency/cost; locks all eight ratings before unmasking. Reviewer must not author cases or alter expected criteria. No paid model judge calls.

stopping.unknown_cost: Retain full pre-send reservation, never classify as zero or reclaim it.

what_user_can_approve: One new two-stage run on existing DeepSeek direct account, deepseek-v4-pro/high, <=14 total calls and <=US$2.00 total (.30 stage1,1.70 stage2 only after stage1 passes), five specified synthetic nonpersonal inputs; one pass/no retries/top-up; narrowly bounded synthetic final-output evidence in the public GitHub repository haohongfei2001-png/human-cognition-layer and a private user summary.
